offers_products.reason: Healthcare REIT leasing outpatient medical buildings and senior housing; no goods or software sold.

offers_services.reason: REITs count as services; it leases outpatient medical space and senior housing properties to tenants and operators.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Senior housing residents choose and live in its assisted living and memory care communities.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Outpatient medical space is leased to healthcare provider tenants; senior housing goes to national operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Rent from long-term leases, 5.3-year average remaining term, plus senior housing resident fees.

cyclical_demand.reason: Needs-based healthcare and senior housing demand with long-term leases and high tenant retention.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay recurring rent or monthly resident fees, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from owned real estate assets, not from staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main tenants are creditworthy healthcare providers and large national senior housing operators.

asset_heavy.reason: Healthcare REIT that must buy and own medical office buildings and senior housing properties to grow.

notes: Consumer and large-customer answers are judgment calls, because senior housing may be operator-run and residents pay indirectly.
